variants.briefing:
We’re on the market for a new stash house, so I sent [TargetName] over to [Location]. They were supposed to just have a quick look and report back to me if any of the hangars would work for us, but I haven’t heard from them since.

My guess is that someone else was already using the hangar, but I’d sleep better knowing for sure.

If the credits seem right, head over and see if you can find out what happened to [TargetName]. Just be careful. I’d hate to have to hire someone to find your body next.

Stows out.
